{
  "name": "temper",
  "displayName": "Temper",
  "description": "Claude cannot write code before you approve the intent. Gated plan, TDD, review and check for AI written code, with a phase bar in Claude Code.",
  "version": "9.7.0",
  "author": {
    "name": "galando",
    "url": "https://github.com/galando"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/galando/temper",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/galando/temper",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "intent-driven-development",
    "sdlc",
    "guardrails",
    "tdd",
    "code-review",
    "quality-gates",
    "blast-radius",
    "workflow",
    "enforcement",
    "plan-mode"
  ],
  "commands": [
    "./commands/temper.md",
    "./commands/intent.md",
    "./commands/plan.md",
    "./commands/design.md",
    "./commands/build.md",
    "./commands/review.md",
    "./commands/check.md",
    "./commands/fix.md",
    "./commands/pack.md",
    "./commands/status.md",
    "./commands/init.md"
  ],
  "agents": [
    "./agents/intent.md",
    "./agents/plan.md",
    "./agents/design.md",
    "./agents/build.md",
    "./agents/build-task.md",
    "./agents/review.md",
    "./agents/check.md",
    "./agents/rca.md",
    "./agents/fix.md"
  ],
  "skills": [
    "./skills/temper-core",
    "./skills/context-engineering",
    "./skills/source-driven-development",
    "./skills/grill-me",
    "./skills/teach-me"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "uiMode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Temper UI mode",
      "description": "How much Temper draws: full, minimal or off. The gate questions, the denials and the subcommands are the same in every mode.",
      "default": "full",
      "sensitive": false
    },
    "enforcement": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Temper enforcement",
      "description": "on refuses writes outside the stage, --no-verify, a changed hooks path, and a step only the person may take without their answer; off keeps the drawing only. Values: on or off.",
      "default": "on",
      "sensitive": false
    },
    "prAttribution": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pull request attribution",
      "description": "on adds one Temper line to Claude Code's attribution text for pull requests. Values: on or off.",
      "default": "on",
      "sensitive": false
    },
    "phaseModels": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Per-phase models",
      "description": "Optional. Comma separated phase=model pairs such as build=sonnet. Empty means no change.",
      "default": "",
      "sensitive": false
    },
    "reviewerModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reviewer model",
      "description": "Optional model for the Temper review agent. Empty means no change.",
      "default": "",
      "sensitive": false
    }
  }
}
